description: Mat stores rows,cols,re and optional im plus class. at(i,j)=re[j*rows+i]. transpose maps destination i*cols+j from source j*rows+i, swaps dimensions and preserves class. narrow removes im iff every entry equals zero (including empty). StrArr records missing strings as None; Exact has no variants.

inverse: For well-formed bounded matrices transpose excludes row-major reinterpretation, dropping nonzero/NaN imaginary data, or class change. narrow excludes Some(all-zero) afterward. Public fields and complex constructor do not exclude inconsistent lengths; new checks re length only in debug.

Transpose is its own inverse on well-formed Mat, including optional-im representation. narrow's None fiber contains prior None and any all-zero imaginary buffer; allocation identity and signed imaginary zero are lost. Char decoding's replacement/saturating conversions lose original f64 payloads.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no semantic proof or executable surrogate
